questions.question: What is the result of conductor skin effect?

choices.A: Resistance increases as frequency increases because RF current flows closer to the surface
choices.B: Resistance decreases as frequency increases because electron mobility increases
choices.C: Resistance increases as temperature increases because of the change in thermal coefficient
choices.D: Resistance decreases as temperature increases because of the change in thermal coefficient

questions.answer: Resistance increases as frequency increases because RF current flows closer to the surface

questions.question: Why is it important to keep lead lengths short for components used in circuits for VHF and above?

choices.A: To increase the thermal time constant

questions.question: What is the phase relationship between current and voltage for reactive power?

choices.C: They are 90 degrees out of phase
choices.D: They are 45 degrees out of phase

questions.answer: They are 90 degrees out of phase

questions.question: Why are short connections used at microwave frequencies?

choices.B: To reduce phase shift along the connection

questions.answer: To reduce phase shift along the connection

questions.question: What parasitic characteristic causes electrolytic capacitors to be unsuitable for use at RF?
What parasitic characteristic creates an inductor’s self-resonance?
What combines to create the self-resonance of a component?

choices.B: The component’s nominal and parasitic reactance
choices.D: The component’s electrical length and impedance

questions.answer: The component’s nominal and parasitic reactance

questions.question: What is the primary cause of loss in film capacitors at RF?
What happens to reactive power in ideal inductors and capacitors?

choices.A: It is dissipated as heat in the circuit
choices.B: Energy is stored in magnetic or electric fields, but power is not dissipated

questions.question: As a conductor’s diameter increases, what is the effect on its electrical length?

choices.A: Thickness has no effect on electrical length

choices.B: Power consumed by an inductor’s wire resistance
